result.topic_en: A German receipt dated Hannover, 4 October 1825, signed by F. Hartmann, Artillery Lieutenant, for fifty thalers paid to him by Captain Müller; at the top Gauss jotted a note on the integral of e^{-nti} f(t) and its expansion into cosine and sine parts.
result.transcription:
$\int e^{-nti} ft.\,dt$

$t = x$ \quad $\cos nx - i \sin nx \; fx\, dx$

Hierdurch bescheinige ich den Empfang von
Fuenfzig Thaler Conventions-M. —
welche mir als Vorschuss[?] von dem Herrn Hauptmann
Müller am heutigen Tage baar ausbezahlt worden sind.
Hannover am 4ten Octbr. 1825.
F. Hartmann
Art.-Lieut.

Rt[?] 50 [?] Conv. M.

methods.what: Integral of f(t) against the complex exponential e^{-int} (a Fourier-type transform or coefficient)
Change of variable t = x and expansion of the exponential by Euler's formula e^{-inx} = cos nx − i sin nx inside the integrand
methods.quote: $t = x$ \quad $\cos nx - i \sin nx \; fx\, dx$
